annotation.title_clean: 事业单位登记管理条例
annotation.title_en: Regulations on the Registration and Administration of Public Institutions
annotation.authors_or_issuer: State Council of the People's Republic of China
named_instruments_referenced: Interim Regulations on the Registration and Administration of Public Institutions
annotation.summary_en: State Council Decree No. 849 issues the Regulations on the Registration and Administration of Public Institutions. They take effect on 1 December 2026 and govern legal-person certificates, registration review, changes, deregistration with liquidation, and annual reporting. They replace the Interim Regulations. The decree has nothing to do with AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Public institutions must obtain legal-person certificates, which are issued within 10 working days
Registration decisions are due within 15 working days, and refusals must give reasons
Certificates expire after a fixed term and must be renewed within 90 days before expiry
A liquidation group must be formed before deregistration
Annual reports, including on Party-building, go through the supervising department by 31 March
